200.description: A new access token; the rotated refresh token is in the cookie

allowPlayerManualModifiers.description: On: players may enter Manual Modifiers in combat, as the DM always may (D164)

promptPlayerRepeatSaves.description: On: players roll their characters' Repeat Saves when prompted; off: the server rolls them (D162)

showExactMonsterHp.description: Off: players see each monster's HP as a Health Status instead of numbers (D157)
